name: Blue-Green Deployment Automation
summary: Implement a blue-green deployment strategy using Azure DevOps and Azure Managed Disks to minimize downtime during updates.
description: This project aims to implement a blue-green deployment strategy utilizing Azure DevOps and Azure Managed Disks to ensure seamless updates with minimal downtime. The blue-green deployment method allows for two identical environments, where one (the blue environment) is live while the other (the green environment) is idle. During updates, changes are deployed to the green environment, and once verified, traffic is switched from blue to green. This approach not only reduces downtime but also mitigates risks associated with deployment failures. The project will involve setting up Azure Managed Disks for both environments, configuring Azure DevOps pipelines for continuous integration and deployment, and establishing monitoring tools to ensure performance and reliability. By the end of this project, clients will have a robust deployment strategy that enhances operational efficiency and improves user experience during updates.
